description_zh: 查看文件存储 HDFS 版文件系统实例的用户和组的映射关系
kebab_example: aliyun dfs list-user-groups-mappings --input-region-id cn-hangzhou --filesystem-id 55C5FFD6-BF99-41BD-9C66-FFF391890000 --next-token user1 --limit 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUserGroupsMappings

parameters.help_en: The region where the file system is located
parameters.name: input_region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the Apsara File Storage for HDFS file system
parameters.help_zh: 文件存储 HDFS 版的文件系统实例ID
parameters.name: filesystem_id

parameters.help_en: Starting point for the next page in a paged query. It is an empty string for the first query. If paged queries are required, the return value of each request includes the NextToken value for the next request
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的下一页起始点，首次查询是为空字符串，如果需要分页查询，则每个请求的返回值中会包含下次请求的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: Number of users to return per query
parameters.help_zh: 每次查询需要返回的用户个数
parameters.name: limit
